## Highlights

- Added TideReader SIP v1 local integration support for LivePanel-style companion apps
- Added service and show launch modes so TideReader can run headless for same-machine integrations
- Enriched SIP status with overlay URL, active profile details, profile count, layout hints, and compact now-playing data
- Tightened release documentation with a concise README and updated SIP API examples
- Aligned installer publisher metadata and fresh-install defaults with the Starsong Installer Standard

## SIP integration

- Added localhost-only SIP endpoints for application identity, health, capabilities, status, profile listing, current profile, and profile activation
- Reserved the `47030-47039` port range for SIP and automatically binds to the first available local port
- Updated the Postman collection and SIP API reference for the current SIP v1 contract
- Kept profile activation as the only mutating SIP endpoint; profile CRUD and full overlay settings remain in the TideReader UI

## Desktop and reliability

- Added service-mode startup readiness checks for backend and SIP endpoints
- Improved startup diagnostics so service-mode failures are easier to identify
- Avoided ASP.NET content-root hangs when launched from UNC paths
- Defaulted fresh installer installs to `%ProgramFiles%\Starsong Tools\TideReader` while preserving existing in-place upgrades
- Added desktop launch configuration coverage for service and show mode behavior

## Security posture

- SIP remains loopback-only and rejects non-localhost `Host` headers
- CORS is not enabled for the SIP listener
- JSON requests reject unknown fields and enforce a small request-body limit
- SIP responses include no-store and browser hardening headers
- Status payloads exclude full settings, output folders, log paths, credentials, browser debug state, and raw detection debug data

## Notes

- This release is a minor version bump because it adds a new local integration surface and service-mode workflow
- Automated frontend coverage, backend coverage, dependency audit, release build, desktop publish, and release packaging checks are expected to pass for this release
